comment: No family is set on the signal inputs or the outputs: a mute passes whatever is given to it. The gate input has no Schmitt trigger and no hysteresis, so it is a level test rather than an edge test. The button states are saved with the patch (dataToJson, src/MentalGates.cpp:57-70). The plugin lists the module under Switch and Utility and the maker's own summary calls it "Gates or Mutes"; what it does is mute.
